title: Add Floating Left-Side Call Button to TrustFix Website

requirements.text: Create a new FloatingCallButton component at `frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButton.tsx`. The button must be: circular, fixed to the middle-left of the screen (`position: fixed; left: 1rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%)`), with a green background (#25D366), a white phone SVG icon, a subtle drop shadow, and a smooth scale-up hover effect. It must stay fixed while scrolling on both desktop and mobile. On click, it triggers `window.location.href = 'tel:8884447229'`. On mobile, a long-press (pointerdown held ≥500ms) should also trigger the call. The button must have `aria-label='Call TrustFix'` and a visible tooltip with text 'Call TrustFix' that appears on hover/focus. Button size should be responsive (e.g., 52px on mobile, 60px on desktop).

quotes: Add a floating CALL button on the LEFT side (mobile + desktop)
Style: circular button, green background (#25D366 style), white phone icon
Add subtle shadow + smooth hover scale effect
Button must stay fixed while scrolling
Long press on mobile should also show call option

acceptanceCriteria: Button is circular with #25D366 background and a white phone icon
Button is fixed at middle-left of the viewport and does not scroll with the page
Clicking the button initiates a call to tel:8884447229
Long-pressing the button on mobile (≥500ms) also triggers the call
A tooltip reading 'Call TrustFix' appears on hover and focus
Button has a visible drop shadow and scales up smoothly on hover
Button size is 52px on mobile and 60px on desktop

requirements.text: Add the FloatingCallButton component to `frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx` alongside the existing FloatingWhatsAppButton. The call button must not overlap the WhatsApp button on the right side. On mobile, both buttons must maintain safe margins from the bottom navigation bar (minimum 80px from bottom) and from each other. The call button is on the left; the WhatsApp button remains on the right — they must never visually conflict.

quotes: Do NOT overlap WhatsApp button on right side
Keep safe margin from bottom navigation bars

acceptanceCriteria: Call button (left) and WhatsApp button (right) do not overlap on any screen size
Both buttons maintain at least 80px clearance from the bottom on mobile
No existing design elements are altered

constraints: Do not modify any existing components, pages, or styles beyond adding the FloatingCallButton and updating Layout.tsx to include it.
Do not alter the FloatingWhatsAppButton component or its positioning.
Immutable paths (frontend/src/hooks/*, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui) must not be touched.
nonGoals: No changes to backend logic, data models, or APIs.
No changes to any existing page content, navigation, or styling.
No WhatsApp integration or modification of the existing WhatsApp button.
